claim: Pending bounded polynomial and original-contact-field principal-part identities for the original infinity localization denominator.
status: UNCOMPILED_DRAFT; hosted strict verification, recursive audit and independent acceptance pending.

obligations.name: Coefficient field
obligations.required: Use a genuine field for polynomial Bezout and division.
obligations.constructed: The generic theorem quantifies over Field K; the contact consumer uses Q.
obligations.justification: No specialized nonsquare, separability or H1 dimension input is introduced.

obligations.name: Original denominator
obligations.required: The concrete D must be the denominator of the actual infinity localization.
obligations.justification: The consumer invokes denominator_at_zero_ne_zero for that same c and D, not a replacement with the same zeros.

obligations.name: All exponents
obligations.required: Cover every natural pole and localization exponent, including zero.
obligations.constructed: n and m are arbitrary natural numbers.
obligations.justification: Coprime powers and monic X^n division apply at zero exponents too; degree less than zero forces the zero remainder without a separate omitted case.

obligations.name: Coprimality input
obligations.required: X and D must be coprime before raising to powers.
obligations.constructed: coprime_coordinate derives this from D.eval 0 not equal to zero.
obligations.justification: Irreducibility of X gives divisibility or coprimality. Evaluating a putative X-divisibility at zero rules out divisibility.

obligations.name: Exact polynomial identity and bound
obligations.required: The principal numerator must have degree below n and the identity must be exact.
obligations.constructed: The proof takes the monic remainder of P times its Bezout coefficient modulo X^n.
obligations.justification: modByMonic_add_div and the Bezout equation give P=R D^m+S X^n with the displayed sign and no dropped unit factor.

obligations.name: Original coordinate and field
obligations.required: Evaluate at the original infinity coordinate inside the original contact field.
obligations.constructed: The consumer uses InfinityFieldCoordinates318.u c and L c with its existing Kummer field structure.
obligations.justification: No unrelated Laurent-series model or newly selected field equivalence replaces the actual coordinate.

obligations.name: Division is valid
obligations.required: Every denominator in the actual field identity must be nonzero.
obligations.constructed: u_ne_zero and denominator_at_u_ne_zero supply both bases; powers inherit nonvanishing.
obligations.justification: D(u) nonvanishing uses the already proved polynomial_coordinate_injective and the original denominator_ne_zero.

obligations.name: Identity consumed downstream
obligations.required: The rational identity must be the evaluation of the exact polynomial decomposition.
obligations.constructed: fraction_decomposition evaluates P=R D^m+S X^n and clears only proved nonzero denominators.
obligations.justification: The remaining numerator bound is unchanged. The infinity-regular term has denominator only D(u)^m and the pole term denominator only u^n.

obligations.name: Scope and validation
obligations.required: Do not infer an actual overlap quotient computation from a field identity.
obligations.constructed: Actual overlap-coefficient representation, regular-term lift, finite-image cancellation and fivefold H1 identification remain separate consumers.
obligations.justification: This is an uncompiled helper continuation with structural checks only. No H1 dimension, spanning, independent acceptance or local Lean success is asserted. Existing denominator and coordinate proofs remain unchanged.
